description: The Modern tower-one at three stars (the towerone fixture with vipFavorable cleared, vipVisits zeroed and the treasury filled) sells its Security office and both Medical centers so a fire is likelier and nothing fights it, runs at hour ticks until a fire breaks out and the rescue offer is pending, pays the rescue so the blaze is put out and the room is gutted, then starts a fire by hand and lets it burn and spread for ten days with no choice offered.
